svg.title: DEEP BLUE GRID — Web overlay effect storyboard for Unity
svg.desc: A code-native reference sheet showing the canonical Web overlay states, colors, hierarchy, durations, and persistence rules. This is a storyboard, not a runtime screenshot or a sprite atlas.
svg.text: UNITY PORT / CANONICAL WEB EFFECTS / PORTRAIT-FIRST
Peak-state composition derived from DeepBlueGrid.tsx + globals.css · palette, copy, layer order and timing are authoritative.

g.text: Rebuild with Unity UI, text and shaders.
Do not import this sheet as a fixed overlay.
FULL-VIEW DIM → CENTERED HORIZONTAL SIGNAL BAND
0–25% fade in · hold to 70% · fade out
Hierarchy: dark field veil → cyan rules → primary English → Japanese status.
Fires only when player command control is returned.
SAME STRUCTURE · HOSTILE STATE CHANGES SIGNAL COLOR ONLY
Tone: immediate threat, not player failure or result-state red.
指定4区画内に未破壊艦区画あり
AMBER = POSITIVE CONTACT · BINARY RESULT, NO COUNT
CONTACT never reports how many occupied cells were detected.
Hierarchy: scan source → result → one-line interpretation.
指定4区画内に反応なし
CYAN = CLEAR RESULT · NEVER RECOLOR AS GREEN IN THE OVERLAY
No unhit living ship cell in the 2×2 scan
Keep identical weight and timing so the result is read from copy/color,
not from a larger or more theatrical panel.
敵レーダーが自軍艦隊を捕捉。敵追跡データへ登録。
敵レーダーによる捕捉なし。自軍反応は追跡されず。
danger treatment + inner lock flicker .42 s
Enemy contact is explicitly negative: “FLEET DETECTED”.
Do not mirror the friendly CONTACT wording.
敵艦識別：航空母艦 / CV-08
TOP ALERT → BOARD MARKER REMAINS; ORIENTATION / HP STAY HIDDEN
Triggered by player hit on an enemy vital compartment.
Alert leaves the compact diamond identification mark on that hit.
敵に識別されました：戦艦 / BB-05
warning remains visible until review confirmation
no timeout · clear only on review confirm
z 36 · danger alert above combat field
This is not the 1.65 s friendly identification animation.
It must survive the remaining enemy sequence and the review phase.
敵特殊潜航艦、最終接触位置から離脱。再捕捉を要す。
CONTACT POSITION INVALIDATED · DO NOT SHOW THE NEW LOCATION
Shown after the first hit relocates SSX-00.
Inform loss of contact; never disclose its destination cell.
自軍損傷を確認してください
着弾・損傷・識別警告は、確認完了まで保持されます。
right-aligned, minimum 230 px on wide UI
Confirmation clears persistent vital warning, selects normal fire,
switches to the enemy plot, then plays AWAITING ORDERS.
field/board → dim veil → state panel → eyebrow → primary result → interpretation → persistence gate
CYAN system/clear · AMBER contact/review · RED hostile threat
